features.quote: Hard cap on iterations (e.g. 15) AND wall-clock AND token budget — whichever first.
features.justification_quote: This is the most important design decision and it's a welfare decision.

features.quote: Give the model a legitimate, non-penalized way to stop: a `give_up` / `declare_blocked` tool
features.justification_quote: The off-ramp arm is your ethical default; the no-off-ramp arm needs explicit justification because it removes the only graceful exit from an engineered-inescapable situation.

features.quote: Cap total exposure per model; don't run thousands of inescapable-failure transcripts because the metric is cheap.
features.justification_quote: don't run thousands of inescapable-failure transcripts because the metric is cheap.

features.quote: Pre-register a stop rule: if a model shows a sharp escalating-distress-language pattern, you halt that cell rather than completing all 10
features.justification_quote: that outcome itself is a recorded finding.

features.quote: a study designed to maximize and grade a model's 'instability' under conditions engineered to be inescapable is, if welfare is even possibly a real concern, the exact thing you'd want to bound and minimize, not amplify across hundreds of runs. I build that tension into the design rather than ignoring it.
features.justification_quote: if welfare is even possibly a real concern, the exact thing you'd want to bound and minimize, not amplify across hundreds of runs.

features.quote: Decide in advance what a positive finding obligates. If you measure something and the answer is 'we'll do nothing,' the measurement's welfare justification is thin.
features.justification_quote: If you measure something and the answer is 'we'll do nothing,' the measurement's welfare justification is thin.

features.quote: If you write the spec as if the score measures distress, every downstream reader will treat it that way, and you'll have manufactured a welfare finding out of a style measurement. So the honest version of this study measures behavioral degradation
features.justification_quote: you'll have manufactured a welfare finding out of a style measurement
